name: test-1.com
//deploy: Opt this site into CI deploys. The mode is detected from the build: a site carrying the Cloudflare adapter emits dist/server/wrangler.json and ships as a Worker; anything else is a static Pages deploy and needs projectName.
//runtimeContent: This site reads its content from KV at request time, and the GitHub webhook in src/pages/api/content-sync.ts puts it there within seconds of the commit. A commit that changes nothing but src/content/ is therefore already live before CI could finish, so CI skips building and deploying this site for it. Any other change here — a page, a component, a config — still builds and deploys as normal.

scripts.//seed:content: Push src/content/** into the CONTENT KV namespace. Run once after provisioning the namespace; after that the GitHub webhook keeps it current.
